name: SwoftyMod
author: Swofty
description: Adds core functionality for addon loading and customisation in Swofty Launcher

options.label: Show launcher panel
options.description: Show the "Launched with Swofty Launcher" panel on the home screen.

options.label: Split the season picker
options.description: Split the Grand Prix, Time Trial and split-screen season picker into Built In and Addons rows. Off keeps the game's single row, without addon seasons. Applies the next time you press Play.

options.label: Swofty startup intro
options.description: Play the 6 second Swofty logo intro in place of the EA SPORTS startup video. Another addon that replaces the startup video takes its place. Applies the next time you press Play.
